title: After sealing the Vale barrow doors ('You draw the great doors shut from within the passage and hear the seal-stone drop. True to your word.' / Tamsin: 'Sealed for good. That's a door that'll hold.'), the room still offers 'go in (toward the barrow)' and walking back in works with no obstacle at all, contradicting the narrative and the promise just made to the reeve.
